scope: Novelty admission and CPU-only cheap falsification; no new GPU/E2E performance campaign
sequence: one combined CPU replay of M2/M3
at most one winner; no implementation without all admission gates

workload.header: 12B: int32 D,N,metric=2; not part of device row alignment
workload.knn_query_selection: first32 kNN events of original Gate3 A, before outcomes
workload.snapshot: initial only; no mutated-snapshot or mixed-workflow replay

m1.primary: fraction of removable coordinate-sector bytes with unchanged required payload
m1.sensitivity: remove all non-coordinate modeled payload including refinement rereads; historical NCU consistency separately, not a universal DRAM floor

m2.single_representation: uint8 uniform interval code for each original dimension0..255; fixed FP64 boundaries and unbounded first/last tails
m2.raw_replay_charge: 256*4*every encoded-screen survivor at256, before continuing later stages
m2.quality: interval containment of all encoded coordinates; every query/object lower bound <= ordered raw prefix at128 and256; no true-hit removal; full fallback membership/scores match oracle
m2.zero_false_positive_meaning: screen may retain extra candidates; exact fallback result must not emit extras
m2.dynamic: not tested; tails are safety design only, no measured maintenance admission

thresholds: oracle final exact eighth score (optimistic/free-threshold ideal only)
fixed first256-row exact eighth score; full seed reads charged
m3.quality: all1M full scores bitwise match preserved ordered oracle for each query; every crossing predecessor<=cutoff<crossing; all exact top-k and ties retained; final k8 CPU membership/scores match reference
m3.primary: oracle first-crossing coordinate-only saving vs N*D*4
m3.report_also: required_dims histograms/quantiles and frozen four-stage rounded payload for both thresholds; seed cost charged
m3.knn_ties: distance then occurrence ID in CPU oracle; never reject equality; not a change to native GPU tie qualification

all_required: direct link to measured traffic or dominant query component
admission.priority: quality/provenance failure stops as unvalidated; independent numeric kill; independent known-mechanism novelty kill; positive headroom cannot rescue novelty
admission.selection: at most one; if multiple distinct admitted candidates, M3 then M2 then M1 by dominant measured bottleneck; no additional sweep
admission.bounded_negative: candidate-specific; not proof of impossibility of all GPU search mechanisms

execution.hardware: INTEL XEON GOLD6530,128 logical CPUs on shared Blackwell host
execution.prequalification: deterministic boundary/tie fixtures and all range/knn queries on first4096 rows
execution.do_not_touch: all foreign processes and all old evidence; no raw input copy/changes
execution.stop: first correctness/input/provenance error or timeout; no automatic full-population restart

timing.scope: counts/logical byte models only; elapsed CPU replay time for operational provenance, not performance
timing.historical_Gate2_NCU: fixed32 query all-kernel totals retained as parent evidence, not a fresh comparator
timing.historical_Gate3: UNCLASSIFIED remains frozen; no implicit promotion from Gate4

publication: task-owned diagnostics, scalar counts/histograms/identities/docs only; raw data/scores/codes/per-pair arrays/private placement stay outside Git; manuscript confidential/unchanged

comparators: strong GPU exhaustive and current Gate2 GPU panel
same_contract: same update trace and full maintenance if dynamic
external_gate.structural_gate: query>=1.5x OR maintenance>=5x lower OR aux representation>=2x smaller OR joint E2E>=1.3x; not a kernel-only gain
